Class StripeService.PostProcessorSettings

private class StripeService.PostProcessorSettings

Data structure for post-processor configuration settings used by SyncStripeCharges to configure API callouts and async job scheduling. Typically deserialized from CodeSettings JSON configuration stored under the STRIPE_SYNC_CHARGES_POSTPROC_SETTINGS key.
